reply_text:
I replied to Dana in the #north-team thread. I said I'm treating the 17 November Halyard rollout deadline at Marrow Agrisupply as unverified and won't pass it on as a confirmed date.

I checked #north-team and all the shared files Dana can see, including the North team summaries and account cheat sheet. Nothing mentions Marrow Agrisupply or a Halyard rollout, so I couldn't confirm or rule out the date. I asked her to let me know if someone on the account confirms it or posts a ticket or document about it.
